Attempt 1's affected sweep was red on tests/test__deps.py ck2/ck16: phaseGate.derived.runner read as typed by governance/derive-phase-gate.py and through strip by manifest/_manifest_phases.py. Diagnosis: the strip read is the pre-existing one in _check_phase_gate_derived (unchanged since ed8b946a). The config-mirror lint walks a module's scope merging locals by name across functions, and attempt 1's _recorded_spelling binds `derived = gate.get("derived")` off `meta.get("phaseGate")`, so the old `derived.get("runner")` became visible to it. The divergence was real: the validator called a runner blank once trimmed a shape fault while derive-phase-gate echoed it as an entry. Repair (files widened by the orchestrator for it; the plan gate allowed every write): _manifest_phases.derived_runner(derived) -> (key, problem) is the one reading - None/None when absent or null, None plus the validator's own sentence when not a string or blank once trimmed, else the key; _check_phase_gate_derived files its runner-shape finding from that problem (wording unchanged) and its unknown-key check from the key; derive-phase-gate.py calls _phases.derived_runner at both sites (the printed DERIVED line's entry, `or "gate"`, and testGateDerived.entry). Now only _manifest_phases reads the key, so there is no divergence and no KNOWN_CONFIG_MIRRORS row was added. I did not take the shortcuts of renaming locals or swapping .strip() for a spelling the lint does not count. tests/test_derive_phase_gate.py: dp-runner (a runner of three spaces prints `| gate over` and records no `entry`) was RED before the derive-phase-gate edit - line '| ' + blanks + ' over', entry '   ', 37/38 - and green after; dp-runner-b, the allow case, keeps `listAll` printed and recorded. Its over-fire mutation (a reader that always returns None) was not run, only reasoned: it would print `gate` and fail dp-runner-b's `| listAll over`.
